annotations.title: Big medical bill in Japan: what's my 高額療養費 monthly cap, how much comes back, does the new yearly cap apply, and what changes in Aug 2027?

description: Applies Japan's high-cost medical expense benefit (高額療養費) as of 2026-11-04 (MHLW review tables 001726232.pdf, 協会けんぽ, Setagaya / Machida / Fukuoka NHI pages). Monthly cap = base + max(0, 10割 total − threshold) × 1% (flat for lower bands), three schedules by treatment month: up to 2026-07; 2026-08…2027-07 (≈7% higher, e.g. income ¥3.7M–7.7M 85,800 + (x − 286,000) × 1%, ≤ ¥3.7M ¥61,500, tax exempt ¥36,900); from 2027-08 twelve bands (e.g. ¥5.1M–6.5M 98,100 + (x − 327,000), ¥6.5M–7.7M 110,400 + (x − 368,000), ¥16.5M+ 342,000 + (x − 1,140,000)). 多数回該当 from the 4th benefit month in 12 (140,100 / 93,000 / 44,400 / 24,600; 34,500 for ≤ ¥2M from 2027-08). New yearly cap per Aug–Jul on what was paid after monthly refunds (¥1.68M / ¥1.11M / ¥530k / ¥410k / ¥290k / 70+ 低所得I ¥180k). 70+ outpatient caps (一般 ¥18,000 → ¥22,000 → ¥28,000/¥22,000, yearly ¥216,000). Income one way: band (y1650, y1410, y1160, y1040, y950, y770, y650, y510, y370, y260, y200, y0, nontaxable, nontaxable_low; ア/イ/ウ/エ/オ accepted), standardMonthlyRemuneration (標準報酬月額), nhiIncome (旧ただし書き所得), taxableIncome (70+ 課税所得), rough annualIncome, or nonTaxable. Optional months tracker (array [{month, totalCost|copay, setting}] or '2026-08:300000,2026-09:300000') auto-applies 多数回 and the yearly cap. Returns verdict (under_cap | cap_applies | many_times_cap | annual_cap_reached), summary, band, schedule, month {monthlyCap, formula, youPay, monthlyRefund, manyTimes}, caps, annualCap {period, amount}, from2027 {youPay, changeJPY}, beforeAug2026, claim {deadline: 2 years from the 1st of the next month}, tracker, steps, notCounted, sources, disclaimer. Use for '高額療養費 いくら戻る', '自己負担限度額 計算', '高額療養費 2027年8月 変更', '年間上限', 'hospital bill Japan how much will I pay', 'Japan medical cost cap'. Insured care only (meals, private rooms, 先進医療 excluded). Educational estimate, not medical, financial or legal advice; the insurer decides.

ageGroup.description: under70 (default) or 70plus (70–74 and 75+ 後期高齢者).

annualIncome.description: Rough annual income (年収) in yen.

burdenRate.description: Copay rate 0.1 / 0.2 / 0.3 (default by age and band).

copay.description: Insured copay paid at the counter (窓口負担) in yen; give this or totalCost.

manyTimes.description: Already had a benefit in 3+ of the last 12 months (多数回).

month.description: Treatment month YYYY-MM (default this month JST); picks the schedule.

nhiIncome.description: NHI 旧ただし書き所得 (household) in yen.

nonTaxable.description: Resident-tax exempt household (住民税非課税).

priorHitMonths.description: Benefit months in the 12 months before.

setting.description: inpatient / household total (default) or outpatient (70+ outpatient-only cap).

standardMonthlyRemuneration.description: Employee insurance 標準報酬月額 in yen (e.g. 300000).

totalCost.description: 10割 total medical cost (総医療費) in yen.
